relevance_note: Single case report of a man with a LAMP2 variant and Danon disease: "Genetic testing revealed a substitution of thymine to cytosine at position 52 (NM_002294.2, NM_013995.2(LAMP2):c.52T>C) in exon 1 of the LAMP-2 gene".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and checked spans/fields. In scope: the patient plus his two children, who were tested ('His two children had normal results.'); they get rows labelled 'child of patient' and 'child of patient 2' (sex not stated), no variant rows, and no phenotypic_features rows because 'normal results' names no specific feature. Parents and siblings were not tested and are described only as untested/out of contact, so they get no rows. Two transcripts are printed together ('NM_002294.2, NM_013995.2(LAMP2):c.52T>C'); both recorded in transcript_as_stated. Protein printed without 'p.' prefix ('Cys18Arg'). Variant type not stated as a class (only 'substitution' / 'Cys18Arg mutation'), so not reported; zygosity not stated (only 'A mosaic pattern was not seen'). Inheritance not reported: parents untested; authors only say de novo is 'quite likely'. Contradiction/tension on pathogenicity: the variant 'has been classified as a variant of unknown significance' yet authors 'believe that this genetic variation is in fact pathogenic'; both recorded. Age 46 is age at referral in 2014, not at last evaluation or diagnosis (follow-up continued to 2016 and later), so those ages are not reported; onset 'in his 30s' has no single number, so ISO left null. LVOT obstruction marked excluded from a peak velocity of 1.4 m/sec with stated normal < 1.7 m/sec (normal finding, D-27). Intellectual disability checklist item excluded from 'no cognitive defect was detected' plus 'He did not have any neurological manifestations of this disease.' Skeletal myopathy excluded from 'did not translate to any form of myopathy'; normal EMG recorded as the paper words it.
